def det_vapp(x):
    u2 = (1 + x) / 2
    fin = False
    while not fin:
        u1 = u2
        print("u1=", u1)
        u2 = (u1 + x / u1) / 2
        print(u2)
        fin = abs(u2 - u1) < 0.0000000000001
    return u2


x = int(input("x= "))
print(det_vapp(x))
